## 🎯 Feature Description

Provide a clear and concise description of the feature you want to implement.

## 📋 Is your feature related to a problem?

Describe the problem or use case this feature would solve. Why is this feature needed?

## 💡 Proposed Solution

Describe how you would like this feature to work. Include:
- User workflow
- Expected behavior
- Key components involved

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered

Describe any alternative approaches or features you've considered and why you prefer your proposed solution.

## 📊 Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Criteria 1
- [ ] Criteria 2
- [ ] Criteria 3

## 📚 Additional Context

Add any other relevant information, mockups, screenshots, or references here.

## 👥 Related Issues

Link any related issues: Closes #, Related to #
